the amounts array parameter is only consumed by receiveNFTs when handling ERC1155 assets
the to parameter is the destination address resolved inside mintTo
the amount parameter is the redemption unit count processed inside redeemTo
specificIds is directly consumed by withdrawNFTsTo to select targeted token ids
the _mintFee parameter is validated and written inside setFees
the _manager parameter is assigned to the manager state variable inside setManager
moduleIndex is forwarded to the eligibility manager inside deployEligibilityStorage
count is the local return value produced by receiveNFTs
totalFee is the local value consumed by _chargeAndDistributeFees
randomIndex is the local index computed inside getRandomTokenIdFromVault
tokenId is the local id selected per loop iteration inside withdrawNFTsTo
